formula_notes: Each movement is closing less opening, in the common reported monetary unit. Modules use gross S.25.01 C0040 (supervisory) or C0110 (public disclosure). Diversification and LAC-TP/LAC-DT retain their reported signs. The R0120 RFF/MAP and R0160 Article 4 adjustments and R0210 capital add-ons are separate lines.

The additive gross basis is documented in mappings/VERIFICATION.md under SCR bridge basis for R-019 (BV254_1-2-7 and BV134-1-6). S.26.01–S.26.03 are cited drill-down schedules only; no S.26 amount feeds a top-level S.25.01 result.

Opening and closing SCR come from S.23.01. The separately displayed residual is closing less opening and all signed movements, assessed against D3. Missing S.25.01 leaves its module detail Unavailable and preserves the S.23.01 headline SCR movement.

formula_notes: D5. E is own funds eligible to meet the SCR (S.23.01 R0540/C0010); S is SCR (S.23.01 R0580/C0010). Subscripts 0 and 1 denote opening and closing. Both SCR amounts must be reported and strictly positive.
Own funds effect = 100 × (E1 − E0) / S0 percentage points.
Interaction = 100 × (E1 − E0) × (1/S1 − 1/S0) percentage points. It is a separate effect and is not allocated to either other line.

The three effects sum exactly to 100 × (E1/S1 − E0/S0). The residual is an identity check and must equal zero. Python retains exact rational values; JSON preserves them as exact decimal or fraction strings. Excel displays six decimal places without rounding formulas.
